## Summary

State the proposed choice in one or two sentences. Do not put secret values, full account identifiers, or personal tax details in this record.

## Context

Describe the measurable problem, current behavior, constraints, and why a decision is needed now. Identify the stage and whether doing nothing remains viable.

## Decision Drivers

- `[Safety or correctness driver]`
- `[Evidence or performance driver]`
- `[Cost or operational driver]`
- `[External broker data tax or regulatory constraint]`

## Decision

Record the selected option, exact effective scope, configuration or schema boundary, and what remains prohibited. A proposed record has no effect until all required approvals are present and status becomes `ACCEPTED`.
